answers.core: I assume the required changes are a bit lower-level than what an asset add-on could do.
answers.workaround: To be comprehensive throughout the whole editor? I doubt it. It is likely that many small things and edge cases need to be adjusted and handled, specifically because of the desire to support a narrow editor layout to make portrait mode work. For just the “tabbed single-view” mode, probably little needs to be done beyond putting the dock nodes in the main central view, adding the corresponding buttons to the title bar, and wrapping the title bar in a ScrollContainer (while also making sure everything inside is set to MOUSE_FILTER_PASS).

title: Mobile Editor UX: Add an optional tabbed single-view layout mode and refactor UI for narrow width
